title: Modeling and Analysis Technique for the Formal Verification of System-on-Chip Address Maps: Extended Abstract
problem: Complex SoC designs require verification that specification and implementation address maps are equivalent, and identifying root causes of discrepancies is challenging.
motivation: Address map errors in SoCs can cause subtle integration failures; formal verification techniques are needed to catch these before silicon.
method: Models both specification and implementation address maps using a unified graph-based representation; performs equivalence analysis on the graph models to identify and localize mismatches.
key_novelty: Graph-based unified model enabling systematic equivalence checking of SoC address maps.
contributions: Unified graph model for representing both specification and implementation address maps
Equivalence analysis technique for identifying address map discrepancies
Demonstration on mid-size industrial SoC design with root cause identification
limitations: Performance scalability and coverage metrics not discussed.
